pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā sikkhamānā thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ upasaṅkamitvā upasampadaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.4: sace me tvaṃ ayye cīvaraṃ dassasi evāhantaṃ vuṭṭhāpessāmīti vatvā neva vuṭṭhāpeti na vuṭṭhāpanāya ussukkaṃ karoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.5: athakho sā sikkhamānā bhikkhunīnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā sikkhamānaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.8: sace me tvaṃ ayye cīvaraṃ dassasi evāhantaṃ vuṭṭhāpessāmīti vatvā neva vuṭṭhāpessati na vuṭṭhāpanāya ussukkaṃ karissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī sikkhamānaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.10: sace me tvaṃ ayye cīvaraṃ dassasi evāhantaṃ vuṭṭhāpessāmīti vatvā neva vuṭṭhāpeti na vuṭṭhāpanāya ussukkaṃ karotīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.13: hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī sikkhamānaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.14: sace me tvaṃ ayye cīvaraṃ dassasi evāhantaṃ vuṭṭhāpessāmīti vatvā neva vuṭṭhāpessati na vuṭṭhāpanāya ussukkaṃ karissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.16: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.17.1: yā pana bhikkhunī sikkhamānaṃ sace me tvaṃ ayye cīvaraṃ dassasi evāhantaṃ vuṭṭhāpessāmīti vatvā sā pacchā anantarāyikinī neva vuṭṭhāpeyya na vuṭṭhāpanāya ussukkaṃ kareyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:2.1.7: sace me tvaṃ ayye cīvaraṃ dassasi evāhantaṃ vuṭṭhāpessāmīti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:2.1.15: neva vuṭṭhāpessāmi na vuṭṭhāpanāya ussukkaṃ karissāmīti dhuraṃ nikkhittamatte āpatti pācittiyassa.
